csv_scope_of_work: The City seeks responsible Firms to develop a minimum of three (3) single family detached dwelling design templates (with variations) that can be applied to City-owned or privately-owned sites, streamlining future development processes, reducing costs, and establishing consistent quality standards for residential infill development. The City of Rockford shall retain ownership of the architectural drawings and related design documents, including but not limited to specifications, and other materials prepared by the selected firm. The City shall have the right to use, reuse, modify, and distribute these materials for any municipal purpose. One of the architectural drawings and related design documents will be used for the property located at 724 7th Avenue, Rockford, IL 61104.

title: Architectural Design Services
short_description: Design of reusable single-family housing templates for residential infill development in Rockford.
project_scope: Development of at least three single-family detached dwelling design templates with variations for use on city-owned or privately owned sites to support residential infill development. One design package will be applied to the property at 724 7th Avenue, Rockford, IL 61104. The city will retain ownership and reuse rights for drawings, specifications, and related design documents.
services: Architectural design services for prototype single-family residential buildings; preparation of architectural drawings, specifications, and related design documents; possible associated civil engineering input.
relevance_explanation:
- Small-scale single-family residential project with low structural complexity.
- Focus is architectural template development, not structural engineering for complex buildings or bridges.
- Does not match sbp priority sectors such as bridges, long-span roofs, sports venues, towers, or major cultural/university buildings.
- Includes residential infill and possible rehabilitation/refurbishment aspects, which are generally not a strategic fit.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Only limited scope information is available: at least three single-family detached dwelling templates, with one intended for 724 7th Avenue in Rockford. This suggests a small residential project, but no reliable USD estimate can be derived from the tender text alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the source. The procurement is for architectural design services for prototype single-family homes, but the documents do not state compensation, fee basis, or estimated design budget.
references_qualifications: Responsible firms for architectural design services; no specific reference counts or qualification thresholds stated in the source.
